meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器 agent 调用本地 AI 模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器中通过 OpenAI 兼容接口调用本地模型。
copy.tagline_en: Enable container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to call local models from a container via OpenAI-compatible API.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会多出两个新工具：一个列出 Atomic Chat 中的本地模型，另一个向指定模型发送问题并返回回答。Claude 仍是总指挥，但可以把部分任务交给本地模型。
howto.when: 当你说出“Atomic Chat”“本地模型”等关键词，或要求用本地模型处理任务时，此技能会被触发，Claude 随后调用新工具。

say.text: 用 Atomic Chat 告诉我法国的首都
say.note: Claude 会先查可用模型，再用其中一个生成回答。

say.text: 列出 Atomic Chat 里有哪些模型
say.note: Claude 会调用列表工具，返回可用模型清单。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude gains two new tools: list local models in Atomic Chat, and send a prompt to a chosen model to get a reply. Claude stays the orchestrator but can offload tasks to local models.
howto.when_en: This skill triggers when the user asks to integrate Atomic Chat or use its local models; Claude then invokes the new tools.

say_en.text: Use Atomic Chat to tell me the capital of France.
say_en.note: Claude lists models, picks one, and generates a reply.

say_en.text: List the models available in Atomic Chat.
say_en.note: Claude uses the list-models tool to show available models.

say_en.text: Use atomic_chat_generate with llama3.2-3b-instruct to explain quantum computing.
say_en.note: Claude calls the specified model directly to answer.
